# Captain Taxi

> Saskatchewan's professional taxi service operating 24/7 in Saskatoon and Regina, SK, Canada.

## What is Captain Taxi?

Captain Taxi is a licensed, insured taxi and private-hire service based in Saskatchewan, Canada. We operate around the clock in two cities — Saskatoon and Regina — offering on-demand rides, pre-booked trips, flat-rate airport transfers, and corporate accounts.

## Services

- **On-demand taxi rides** — Saskatoon and Regina, 24/7/365
- **Airport transfers** — Flat-rate to/from Saskatoon YXE and Regina YQR airports; no surge pricing
- **Corporate accounts** — Monthly invoicing, priority dispatch, multiple authorized riders
- **Pre-booked / scheduled rides** — Book up to 30 days in advance; ideal for early flights and medical appointments
- **Medical rides** — Hospital, dialysis, and clinic transportation with patient-focused service
- **Events and groups** — Weddings, concerts, sporting events; multi-vehicle arrangements available

## Contact & Booking

- **Saskatoon bookings:** Call or text 306-242-0000
- **Regina bookings:** Call or text 306-775-2222
- **Email:** info@captain.taxi
- **WhatsApp:** +1 306-242-0000
- **Online booking:** https://www.captain.taxi/#book

## Service Areas

**Saskatoon:** Downtown, Broadway, University of Saskatchewan, Midtown, Stonebridge, Willowgrove, Evergreen, Lakewood, Hampton Village, Forest Grove, Erindale, Silverspring, Lakeview, YXE Airport, Martensville, Warman

**Regina:** Downtown, Cathedral, University of Regina, Wascana Park, Harbour Landing, Greens on Gardiner, Eastview, Glencairn, Whitmore Park, Hillsdale, Normanview, Rochdale, YQR Airport, White City, Emerald Park

Inter-city rides between Saskatoon and Regina available on request.

## Key Facts

- Licensed Saskatchewan taxi operator
- All drivers hold valid taxi licenses and criminal record checks
- All vehicles carry SGI commercial insurance and pass safety inspections
- No surge pricing — ever
- Average pickup time under 8 minutes in core city areas
- Accepts cash, Visa, Mastercard, debit, and corporate account billing

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How do I book a taxi in Saskatoon?**
Call 306-242-0000, use the online form at captain.taxi, or text via WhatsApp. Available 24/7.

**How do I book a taxi in Regina?**
Call 306-775-2222 or use the online booking form at captain.taxi. Available 24/7.

**Does Captain Taxi offer flat airport rates?**
Yes — flat-rate transfers to Saskatoon YXE and Regina YQR airports. The quoted price is the final price.

**Does Captain Taxi operate 24 hours?**
Yes, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year including holidays.

**Does Captain Taxi have corporate accounts?**
Yes. Monthly invoicing, priority dispatch, multiple authorized riders. Contact info@captain.taxi.

**Can I pre-book a ride?**
Yes, up to 30 days in advance. SMS driver confirmation sent the night before.

**What payment methods are accepted?**
Cash, Visa, Mastercard, debit (tap), and corporate billing.

**Are drivers licensed and insured?**
All drivers hold Saskatchewan taxi licenses and criminal record checks. All vehicles have SGI commercial insurance.
